points: Gaal talked big: who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him? He asked why they should be serving this Israelite at all.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble

points: When Zebul the ruler of the city, Abimelech's officer, heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled. He sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal and his brethren fortify the city against thee.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble

points: Gaal went out before the men of Shechem and fought with Abimelech, and Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate. Abimelech dwelt at Arumah, and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

note.label: Judges 9: Abimelech and the Fire Out of the Bramble
